description:
Her full name is Sakura Suzuhara.
She holds the rank of second lieutenant and medical officer in WILLE, an organization led by Misato Katsuragi.
Though gentle by nature, she is capable of exhibiting strength and determination in emergencies.

lines.text: Even in a world without the Evangelion war, it's still tough here...
I wonder what my brother is doing in the village now...
It's not a good idea to overwork yourself all the time.
You resemble Ms. Misato, whom I admire. Both of you are remarkable individuals.
If saving you all is what's expected of me, then leave it to me!

You might be zoning out because you're tired.
Are you sure you don't need to rest?
Hmm? Are you asleep? You've worked yourself to the bone.
Do I have to live here with the Nikkes?
Wow! This looks even better than the previous temporary base.

I am Lieutenant Sakura Suzuhara, the medical officer at WILLE.
If there are any medical-related matters that need attending to, I'm the one to talk to.
You're not a Nikke, so be careful and stay safe.
If you're ever injured, come see me.
I... er... I've made a personal training plan for you.
Shh, you need to be cautious.
Do we have to fight again...?
I need to fall back for now. Let me take care of everyone's wounds.
